label: Supply Cache
summary: Trade a little food for the timber needed to keep your village growing.
prompt: Add a “Supply Cache” at the Basic Toolmaking research handoff that trades 5 food for 20 wood instantly, has a highly visible pulsing card and a 120-second cooldown, includes an Elder line directing the player back to Research, and uses a wooden supply-crate emblem.

plugin.title: Supply Cache
plugin.visual_prompt: Painted Celtic storybook game emblem, a neat stack of cut timber logs with visible round log ends and bark, tied with rope, beside an open wooden crate and a small grain sack, warm ochre and forest green, bold readable silhouette, plain cream background, no text.
plugin.advisor_intro: Short of timber, Chief? Trade a little food at the Supply Cache, then carry on with your research.

label: Elder's Counsel
summary: Ask the Elder what to do next before spending your supplies.
prompt: Add an “Elder's Counsel” card at the Basic Toolmaking research handoff that reminds the player their next task is Basic Toolmaking and to check its wood cost in Research before spending timber elsewhere, with a parchment emblem and an Elder line.

plugin.title: Elder's Counsel
plugin.visual_prompt: Painted Celtic storybook game emblem, an unfurled parchment beside a small carved wooden pointer, warm ivory and muted blue, bold readable silhouette, plain cream background, no letters or symbols resembling text.
plugin.description: Your next task is Basic Toolmaking. Open Research and check its wood cost before spending timber elsewhere.
plugin.advisor_intro: Open Research and learn Basic Toolmaking next, Chief. My counsel is here if the day's work slips your mind.

label: Harvest Bargain
summary: Exchange spare timber for a generous basket of food.
prompt: Add a “Harvest Bargain” at the farm step that trades 10 wood for 30 food, with a tempting golden card, a woven grain-basket emblem, and an Elder warning to keep enough timber for the work ahead.

plugin.title: Harvest Bargain
plugin.visual_prompt: Painted Celtic storybook game emblem, a woven basket overflowing with grain and bread beside a small timber bundle, honey gold and russet, bold readable silhouette, plain cream background, no text.
plugin.description: Trade 10 wood for 30 food. Keep enough timber for your next building and research.
plugin.advisor_intro: A tempting bargain, Chief: timber for food. Mind you leave enough wood for the work ahead.
